EXPLORE-001.title: Explore context for ISS-20260414-001
EXPLORE-001.findings: Reproduced the blocker on current HEAD with Windows PowerShell. scripts/check-writing-helper.ps1 is UTF-8 without BOM, contains non-ASCII literals, and fails to parse before request assertions; pwsh parses it. Fix scope touches the script plus release/sign-off wiring and must preserve the existing writing-helper endpoint contract.

EXPLORE-002.title: Explore context for ISS-20260414-002
EXPLORE-002.findings: Release summary GO is computed from scripts/release_check_summary.py's internal blocking checks only, and that modeled set does not include the strict writing-helper acceptance gate. Strategy, SIGN_OFF, and external-release-gate all treat writing-helper acceptance as blocking, while authority-alignment and delivery-gate only validate static anchors. Retained GO evidence therefore inherits a blind spot rather than the real release verdict.

SOLVE-001.title: Plan solution for ISS-20260414-001
SOLVE-001.findings: Planned a minimal compatibility fix: keep /writing-helper/process behavior unchanged, re-save scripts/check-writing-helper.ps1 with a Windows PowerShell-safe BOM, move the blocking acceptance path onto powershell.exe, and pin the shell/encoding contract in existing governance script tests.

SOLVE-002.title: Plan solution for ISS-20260414-002
SOLVE-002.findings: Planned a minimal safe fix: emit retained strict writing-helper acceptance evidence, make release_check_summary.py treat it as a blocking same-HEAD signal, and lock the contract with delivery_gate/SIGN_OFF/governance tests.

AUDIT-001.title: Review solution plans for release blockers
AUDIT-001.findings: ISS-20260414-001 approved as a minimal BOM plus Windows PowerShell compatibility fix. ISS-20260414-002 raised concerns because it shares script/workflow edits with ISS-20260414-001 and should add malformed-artifact regression coverage for the new release-summary signal.

MARSHAL-001.title: Create execution queue for release blockers
MARSHAL-001.findings: Created a sequential release-blocker queue with ISS-20260414-001 first and ISS-20260414-002 explicitly dependent on it because both plans modify the PowerShell acceptance script and workflow wiring. Added a queue requirement for ISS-20260414-002 to cover malformed JSON and missing required keys in the new writing_helper_acceptance_signal path.
